operations.text:
### ADDED ACME-SP-0003 — Reject a malformed reserved range

The allocator SHALL refuse a `reserved` range whose start is greater than its end.

#### Scenario: inverted range
- **WHEN** `reserved.task` is `[[249, 200]]`
- **THEN** project validation reports an error naming the range

operations.title: Allocate spec numbers by index scan
operations.statement: WHEN a spec is created, the allocator SHALL assign the next free number.
operations.text:
### ADDED ACME-SP-0005 — Allocate spec numbers by index scan
Supersedes: ACME-SP-0003.R7

WHEN a spec is created, the allocator SHALL assign the next free number.

#### Scenario: a gap is kept
- **WHEN** the highest spec is `ACME-SP-0004`
- **THEN** the next spec is `ACME-SP-0005`

operations.title: Allocate the next ID by index scan
operations.statement: WHEN an item is created, the allocator shall assign the next number fast.

scenarios.name: a stale counter hint is ignored

operations.text:
### MODIFIED ACME-SP-0003.R2 — Allocate the next ID by index scan

WHEN an item is created, the allocator shall assign the next number fast.

```markdown
### MODIFIED ACME-SP-0003.R8 — inside a fence, not an operation
```

#### Scenario: a stale counter hint is ignored
- **WHEN** `id_allocation.counters.task` is 12 and the scan finds 108
- **THEN** the next task is `ACME-T-0109`

operations.title: Bad supersedes line
operations.statement: The allocator SHALL refuse a duplicate range.
operations.text:
### ADDED ACME-SP-0003 — Bad supersedes line
Supersedes: the old rule

The allocator SHALL refuse a duplicate range.

#### Scenario: duplicate
- **WHEN** two ranges overlap
- **THEN** validation reports both

findings.message: REMOVED ACME-SP-0003.R5 has no "Reason:" line: say why the requirement goes
Spec Delta heading of MODIFIED ACME-SP-0003.R6 uses "-" instead of "—"
Supersedes: "the old rule" is not a requirement ref: want <SPEC-ID>.R<n>
Spec Delta heading "### CHANGED ACME-SP-0003.R2 — Unknown operation" has no operation: want "### ADDED <SPEC-ID> — <title>", "### MODIFIED <REQREF> — <title>" or "### REMOVED <REQREF> — <title>"
MODIFIED names the spec ACME-SP-0003: want the requirement it changes, <SPEC-ID>.R<n>
"ACME-SP-0003.R02" is not a requirement ref: want <KEY>-SP-<NNNN>.R<n> with an unpadded R<n>
ADDED ACME-US-0001 names a story: a Spec Delta changes a spec or a requirement
Spec Delta heading "### MODIFIED ACME-SP-0003.R3" has no " — <title>" after its target: want "### ADDED <SPEC-ID> — <title>", "### MODIFIED <REQREF> — <title>" or "### REMOVED <REQREF> — <title>"
